purpose: Final evaluation of the previously frozen review-activity predictor, after SF became exposed development evidence
holdout_rule: All candidate-category, not-permanently-closed Places outside Oakland/Berkeley/San Francisco, inside a TIGER incorporated city (LSAD 25), and inside a supplied ACS tract in Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin or San Mateo county. No sampling or selection by review count, error or model performance.
primary_metric: Unweighted macro-average RMSE across clinic and grocery, each compared with the frozen category-median baseline
subgroups: Each of the four holdout counties; low/high/missing income at frozen Oakland+Berkeley threshold $106938; low/high/missing population density at frozen threshold 5583.172577533759 per km2
failure_examples: Ten largest absolute log-count errors, stable tie-break by place_id
no_tuning: Do not refit, change parameters, choose categories, alter labels, update feature rules or switch deployment policy using these results. Report results even if baseline wins.
context_disclosure: Bay Area business coordinates and non-target service tags were already used as spatial context. New holdout review-count labels and performance were excluded from the original three-city feature/fit/evaluation pipeline. This is label-held-out evaluation in known geographic context, not wholly unseen source data.
manual_review: Team confirms personal review of the existing 160-listing category sample. Checker audit and Data responses remain linked; unresolved cases must remain disclosed.
eligibility_boundary: Evidence supports an Advanced Track submission; organizers decide eligibility. This protocol does not erase prior SF exposure.
